findings.text: non-blocking: the matrix-parity test is the only assertion that fails on a wrong channel cache and the negative control shows it failing at 4.9e-2, yet it calls pytest.skip unless BANK_REFERENCE_SOURCE names an archived base tree, and :23 marks the module slow so the repository's default lane excludes it; the shipped tree alone therefore cannot re-run the guard, and a later regression in the cached channels or the VJP rows would pass CI silently.

non-blocking: the record attributes the 76.53% sixteen-slice converged-wall regression to the cached channels, but the assembled matrices agree to 1.35e-17, the one-slice step count moves the opposite way (4 to 3), and the worst head fresh residual sits at 9.607e-11 against the 1e-10 bound, so the batch wall is set by one lane at the convergence threshold; the record should name that lane and show the run repeating before the regression is read as a property of the change.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit from 1de330a8f through 03d272e5f, d79451536, ee98954b8 and 2aa3ece1c; it adds the cached field and its two builders, replaces 3*cells directional fields with one VJP per stationary point, leaves the fresh_geometry branch untouched, and adds the test, prototypes, figure and evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for matrix parity within 1e-12 at one and sixteen lanes, isolated and converged walls at 1 and 16 slices on one H200 with every precision budget met; the manifest and logs record 1.3541446305345831e-17 parity, 17 passing device lanes and both wall tables with EXIT=0 and EXIT=1 receipts.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to cache the state-independent bank channels once per operand set and have step_jacobian read them; nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:75 declares the field, :517 builds it and :1186 reads it in place of the per-direction vmap.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records four focused tests, eight driver tests and thirteen support tests passing at head, the 94380000-byte cache, and it prints the 76.53% sixteen-slice converged-wall regression rather than claiming a speedup.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are nova/equilibrium/support_read.py, tests/test_bank_step_channels.py, scripts/prototypes/bank_step_channels and the two docs paths; every path in the diff lies inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_bank_step_channels.py:82 fails on zeroed channels and on a wrong VJP row as the negative control shows, but :36 skips that test without an archived base tree and :23 keeps the whole module out of the default lane.
justifications.evidence: the base-against-head walls and the precision table from scripts/prototypes/bank_step_channels/measure.py and compare.py are recorded with logs and EXIT lines, but the sixteen-slice converged-wall figure rests on one run whose step count swung 10 to 19 without an identified lane.
justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:530 uses the same jax.vjp-at-zero idiom as nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:3014 and the field docstring follows the class's leaf description, with the module's only @jax.jit introduced at :516.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:1186 reads the cached channels and :534 supplies the axis and boundary rows by transpose, so the mechanism the goal names is what landed, though its measured end-to-end effect at sixteen slices is negative.
justifications.reuse: no owner exists for cached bank channels; the search over nova/equilibrium found fixed_points.RowCache as a bounded coupling-row cache for point solves and the vjp row idiom only as a local expression, neither of which this addition re-implements.
justifications.scope_discipline: every file in the diff of 1de330a8f..2aa3ece1c lies inside the declared write paths, and the fresh_geometry branch the brief excused is textually unchanged.
